{{Top|leg}}
'''Boku Settlement''' was a small town on the barren [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[G'rho]]. The settlement was built near an [[Ore/Legends|ore]] vein, away from [[juvica]] highlands. The planet's small militia was based out of Boku, commanded by the [[Ilwizzt]] [[Brco]]. When the [[Ssi-ruu]] invaded the planet, they landed troops at the settlement, capturing a number of the locals for [[entechment]].
